sql: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, at, program_row_id, best_yes_bid, best_no_bid, yes_depth_at_best, no_depth_at_best, est_yes_score_total AS fy, est_no_score_total AS fn, est_yes_meets_target AS my, est_no_meets_target AS mn FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at > now() - interval '6 hours' AND book_valid ORDER BY market_ticker, at DESC), j AS (SELECT s.*, p.series_ticker, p.close_time, p.end_date, p.period_reward_usd / greatest(extract(epoch FROM (p.end_date - p.start_date)) / 86400.0, 0.04) AS pool_day, LEAST(coalesce(s.best_yes_bid,0), coalesce(s.best_no_bid,0)) AS lo FROM s JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id = s.program_row_id WHERE coalesce(p.incentive_type,'') ILIKE '%liquid%' AND p.end_date > now()) SELECT CASE WHEN lo BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'a' WHEN lo BETWEEN 11 AND 25 THEN 'b' WHEN lo BETWEEN 26 AND 40 THEN 'c' WHEN lo > 40 THEN 'd' ELSE 'z' END AS band, series_ticker, count(*) AS mkts, round(sum(pool_day)::numeric, 0) AS pool_day, min(best_yes_bid) AS min_yb, max(best_yes_bid) AS max_yb, min(best_no_bid) AS min_nb, max(best_no_bid) AS max_nb, round(avg(fy)::numeric, 0) AS avg_fy, round(avg(fn)::numeric, 0) AS avg_fn, bool_and(my) AS all_my, bool_and(mn) AS all_mn, min(close_time)::date AS first_close FROM j GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 4 DESC
